scope: Refresh LibreDWG peer artifact provenance and distinguish its DXB support from ASCII/Binary DXF parity; update only existing peer-admission and format-route plan gates.

method.kind: Read-only review of official LibreDWG release artifacts/source and Autodesk format references, reconciled against the existing parity plan
method.evidenceRule: Release pages establish artifact identity and project claims, not conformance. Actual output magic/version, strict independent reopen, diagnostics, and record/owner/payload identity are required for any peer acceptance label. Autodesk format references define the DXF/DXB distinction; ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

observed: The signed 0.14 release is tagged at commit d9468ae and advertises R2004 DWG encoding.
The 0.14 release page characterizes R2010/R2013/R2018 output as experimental with CRC errors on import; NEWS says R2007 encoding falls back to R2010.
The current mutable NEWS file contains a 0.14.1 beta section dated 2026-07-25, but no signed/tagged 0.14.1 GitHub release was found.
The latest visible prerelease artifact checked was 0.14.8597 at commit 34f02f5, dated 2026-09-10; mutable master may contain later source changes.
doesNotEstablish: that the project's release claims establish DWG conformance
that 0.14.1 NEWS is a released or immutable package
that a requested output version equals the version actually emitted
that prerelease or mutable-source output is semantically correct
evidence.planUse: Record release class, exact commit/tag, package/executable identity, artifact hash, platform, requested target, actual six-byte DWG magic, CRC/read diagnostics, and independent reopen separately. Permit the signed 0.14 artifact only as an optional AC1018/R2004 diagnostic; do not score R2007 fallback or experimental later-version output as positive target-version parity.

evidence.topic: DXB is distinct from ASCII and Binary DXF
observed: Autodesk documents Binary DXF as the full DXF group/value representation beginning with the AutoCAD Binary DXF sentinel.
Autodesk documents DXB separately as a plotting/interchange route that emits 16-bit vectors and is commonly used to flatten 3D to 2D.
LibreDWG 0.14 added DXB support; that feature does not establish Binary DXF support or full drawing semantics.
doesNotEstablish: that DXB preserves entity/object graphs, metadata, meshes, ACIS payloads, or DWG semantics
that a DXB test covers Binary DXF group-code/value handling
evidence.planUse: Represent ASCII DXF, Binary DXF, and DXB as separate routes. Admit Binary DXF results only from .dxf output identified by the documented sentinel and decoded group/value stream. Treat DXB, if tested, as a separate lossy vector-projection diagnostic.

evidence.topic: Peer roundtrip independence and output identity
observed: The README advertises broad converter coverage and approximate conversion coverage figures.
The source roundtrip script invokes ODA File Converter when available, so a LibreDWG-plus-ODA flow must be described as multiple stages, not one independent LibreDWG semantic oracle.
doesNotEstablish: per-entity preservation from aggregate coverage percentages
independence of a same-tool read-write-read cycle
semantic acceptance from converter exit status or file existence alone
evidence.planUse: At the existing composed optional checkpoint, separate peer parse/output, external converter, and independent strict readback. Compare exact record/object identity, owner paths, and payload dispositions; retain aggregate counts only as secondary diagnostics.
